about:

The business provides promotional products and corporate gifts, backed by in-house screen printing and embroidery capabilities as well as e-commerce store creation and order fulfillment. Its product line spans thousands of SKUs, including drinkware such as the Shake-It compartment bottle, custom printed apparel, blankets, tech accessories, and a variety of household items. The company also offers a virtual sampling tool for clients to preview designs.

The company lists health care and pharmaceutical organizations among its served industries. Its marketing materials also highlight collections tailored for banking, sports, awards and recognition, travel, and trade-show promotions.

According to its own description, North Country Sportswear differentiates itself through high-quality merchandise, fast turnaround times, pricing that fits various budgets, and the application of promotional-product expertise to deliver customized recommendations for each client.

name: North Idaho Log Furniture Co
old_description: Founded by skilled local artisans with a shared love for woodworking and the outdoors, North Idaho Log Furniture Company was built on three simple principles: quality, integrity, and authenticity.
about:
Based in Dalton Gardens, Idaho, with a showroom in nearby Coeur d'Alene, North Idaho Log Furniture Company was founded in 1996 by Dan and Kelli Booterbaugh. The couple started the business as a small mountain workshop driven by a shared passion for woodworking and the outdoors.

The company handcrafts solid-wood log furniture for every room: beds, bunk beds, tables, chairs, dressers, cabinets, desks, nightstands, couches, mantels, and lamps. Using Lodgepole Pine, Ponderosa Pine, and Hickory harvested from North Idaho forests, each log is hand-selected, hand-peeled, sanded, and joined with traditional mortise-and-tenon construction. Finishes are eco-conscious stains and protective oils. The shop builds custom pieces to order and constructs custom pallets for each shipment, calculating freight individually rather than using a cart-based checkout.

The company serves homeowners, cabin builders, and interior designers across the United States. Customers range from individuals furnishing mountain cabins and lakeside retreats to design professionals specifying rustic pieces for residential projects.

The founders emphasize three principles: quality, integrity, and authenticity. They position their work as a continuation of Idaho craftsmanship, highlighting hand-built joinery, responsible sourcing, and a made-to-order model that avoids mass production. The goal is furniture that "lives with you" for generations.

about:
NorthWoods Manufacturing was founded in 2005 in Lancaster, New Hampshire. The company operates as a custom cabinet shop serving residential and commercial clients across northern New Hampshire, northern Vermont, and western Massachusetts.

The shop produces custom kitchens, bathroom vanities, countertops, and closet systems, and also offers CNC machining services for cabinet components. With a team of eleven skilled craftsmen, NorthWoods uses computer-controlled equipment to cut and fabricate parts, supplying both finished cabinets shipped throughout the United States and Canada and raw components to other cabinet shops that outsource cutting to control costs and quality.

Customers range from local homeowners and custom builders to commercial contractors; notable projects include a kitchenette for North Country Ford in Lancaster, cabinetry for Weeks Medical Center, and CNC-machined parts for B.O.H. Interiors. The company also partners with cabinet shops nationwide that rely on NorthWoods for precision-cut components.

NorthWoods emphasizes that all products are manufactured in its Lancaster facility, positioning itself as a one-stop source for design, fabrication, and delivery. The business grew from a focus on thoughtful, affordable design and aims to give clients a kitchen they “love,” not just one they are happy with.

about:
Northeast Fabricators & Mechanical Services operates from a 32,000-square-foot facility in Dalton, Massachusetts, at Ashuelot Park. The company was formed in February 2001 and has grown from a two-person operation to a team of 19 skilled craftsmen, including welders, pipers, millwrights, and mechanics.

The shop provides full-service welding and metal fabrication, offering in-house production and on-site field support. Capabilities span high-definition CNC plasma cutting, structural welding (MIG, TIG, stick, soldering, brazing), metal forming, piping, shearing, sawing, drilling, tapping, pipe bending, and heavy equipment rebuilds. The team works with steel, stainless steel, mild steel, aluminum, and various tubing profiles, using CAD/CAM design support to turn prints into finished parts such as custom tanks, armor plates, water filtration equipment, pump skids, and chemical dosing systems.

Customers include paper mills, construction firms, industrial and commercial clients across Western Massachusetts, and defense-sector buyers requiring armor plates, gas tanks, and other specialty fabrications. The company also builds commercial snow plow frames, trailer rebuilds, retail display racks, and custom signage.

Leadership emphasizes craftsmanship, innovative solutions, reliability, and responsiveness as the foundation of its reputation. The mission centers on maintaining state-of-the-art equipment, fostering teamwork, and investing in tools that enable the highest quality work, with a stated goal of 100 percent customer satisfaction.

about:
Northeast Foreign Cars operates in White River Junction, Vermont, and has served the Upper Valley region of Vermont and New Hampshire since 1981. The business was established over four decades ago, though the input does not name the founders or specify an ownership structure such as family- or veteran-owned.

The company provides auto repair, general maintenance, and auto parts sales, along with a selection of used foreign and domestic cars. Services include check-engine diagnostics, oil changes, tire rotations and balancing, tune-ups, and emissions maintenance. The parts inventory covers brakes, suspensions, gaskets, filters, and other maintenance and wear items, with common items kept in stock and dealer parts ordered as needed. Facility size and headcount are not disclosed.

Customers are primarily passenger-vehicle owners in the Upper Valley area of Vermont and New Hampshire. The shop works on both foreign and domestic cars, serving individual drivers and fleets needing routine maintenance, repairs, or replacement parts.

The company emphasizes honest care, clear communication, and completing repairs correctly the first time. It highlights its long-standing local presence and a reputation built on fair pricing and avoiding unnecessary upsells.

name: Northeast Millwork Corporation
old_description: Owned and operated by Peter Corr who began his 40 year custom home building career in 1969, and ending in 2008.
about:
Northeast Millwork Corporation operates from an 11,200-square-foot shop in Tiverton, Rhode Island. The company was founded in 1993 by Peter Corr, who had spent four decades in custom home building starting in 1969. Corr’s experience included constructing over 30 new homes, completing more than 100 renovations, and restoring six National Register properties. His work with antique wood began in 1981 through a partnership with Oliver Durfee’s Sawmill, where he specialized in sawing antique longleaf southern pine and reclaimed timber for post-and-beam homes.

The shop houses a 1949 Lane sawmill capable of cutting beams over 40 feet long and 36 inches wide, supplemented by a WoodMizer sawmill for beams up to 20 feet. Northeast Millwork produces antique heart pine flooring in vertical grain, plainsawn, and cabin grades, as well as antique American chestnut flooring. Custom millwork includes mantels, handrails, stair treads, newel posts, balusters, tables, doors, windows, dentils, brackets, countertops, casings, and moulding runs. The company also fabricates antique longleaf pine and American chestnut post-and-beam frames, and salvages materials from 1700s-era textile mills and houses, including granite, bluestone, brick, barn board, and original antique flooring. A current project involves restoring a 1985 Shannon 51-foot ketch.

The firm serves custom home builders, renovation contractors, and architects seeking historic wood elements for new construction, additions, and restoration projects. Commercial clients have included bars, restaurants, and metal building projects. The marine restoration portfolio covers historic J‑Boats such as Endeavor, Shamrock, Corrinett, and Cotton Blossom, along with Shannon yachts. Historic preservation work extends to six National Register homes.

Corr founded the millwork operation after recognizing that many of his building clients wanted the antique wood aesthetic incorporated into their projects, a demand that existing suppliers could not meet with authentic, large-dimension reclaimed material.

name: Northeast Restaurant Equipment
old_description: Here at Northeast Restaurant Equipment, we are committed to providing superior customer service and quality. Our large selection of restaurant-grade kitchen equipment ensures that you find exactly what you need to keep your business running smoothly. Since 1993, we've carried an extensive selection of the finest name-brand kitchen equipment, including freezers, deep fryers, bar refrigeration equipment, and so much more.
about:
Northeast Restaurant Equipment has operated from Mashpee, Massachusetts since 1993 as a locally owned supplier of commercial kitchen equipment. The company serves food service operations across Cape Cod, New Bedford, and the broader Massachusetts region from its showroom and distribution center.

The distributor stocks a range of name-brand equipment including sandwich prep tables, bar refrigeration, reach-in refrigerators and freezers, cooking equipment such as broilers and gas ranges, walk-in coolers, ice machines, and smallwares. Brands carried include Atosa, Beverage-Air, Blodgett, Continental, Royal, Southbend, True, Turbo Air, and Venancio. Northeast Restaurant Equipment provides free delivery throughout Massachusetts, professional installation and setup of new units, and removal of old equipment. All products are backed by warranties of up to five years, and Energy Star rebate assistance is offered on qualifying items.

The company primarily serves independent restaurants, bars, and commercial kitchens in coastal and urban New England markets. Its inventory is tailored to the seasonal demands and high-volume needs of food service operators in areas such as Cape Cod and New Bedford. Customers can purchase directly from the showroom floor for same-day pickup or schedule delivery.

Northeast Restaurant Equipment emphasizes a full-service approach that combines competitive pricing with logistical support: free statewide delivery, old-equipment removal, professional placement, and extended warranty coverage. The locally owned business leverages over three decades of regional experience to anticipate the specific challenges of New England kitchen operations.

name: Northeast Solar
old_description: Electric rates are unpredictable. Power disruptions are increasing. Utility companies still decide what you pay.
about:
Northeast Solar is a residential energy services company based in Hatfield, Massachusetts, founded in 2015. The company serves homeowners across four counties in Western Massachusetts, offering integrated energy systems that combine solar generation, battery storage, heat-pump mini-splits, and electric-vehicle charging. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The firm designs and installs complete home energy systems rather than selling standalone equipment. Its "Power Plan" assessment evaluates a home's current energy use, roof potential, and owner goals to specify a tailored mix of solar photovoltaics, Enphase microinverter-based storage, Mitsubishi Electric mini-splits, and EV chargers. All installation work is performed by Northeast Solar's own licensed employees; the company does not use subcontractors. Since inception it has completed more than 2,000 installations.

The customer base consists exclusively of residential property owners in Western Massachusetts seeking to replace variable utility bills with fixed-cost energy, improve resilience during grid outages, and reduce heating and cooling expenses. Typical projects include solar leases with zero down payment and a 25-year fixed rate, mini-split retrofits that qualify for Mass Save rebates up to $8,500, and battery systems that provide backup power.

Northeast Solar differentiates itself by maintaining a single, directly employed crew across all trades, a 10-year workmanship warranty, and certifications including A+ Better Business Bureau rating (since 2015), Enphase Gold Installer status, Mitsubishi Diamond Installer status, and Mass Save Certified Heat Pump Installer designation. The company emphasizes long-term local support over rapid growth.

name: Northern Furniture Manufacturing LLC
old_description: We are a family owned business dedicated to building high quality upholstered furniture in the USA for major retailers.
about:
Northern Furniture Manufacturing LLC was established in 2021 in Grantsburg, Wisconsin, when Fresh Industries—a global home-furnishings sourcing company founded in 2009—acquired the former Northern Manufacturing Co. from the Norenberg family. The business operates as a family-owned venture dedicated to domestic upholstered furniture production, reviving an industry that had existed in the town since the 1950s.

The company designs and builds modern upholstered furniture—including sofas, chairs, ottomans, and beds—for major retailers. Production is made-to-order and scaled for global distribution, with all manufacturing taking place at its Grantsburg facility. Northern Furniture emphasizes hiring and training local talent, though specific facility size, headcount, and annual volume are not disclosed.

Its customers are lifestyle-focused brands and major retailers that sell through stores and online channels. The company serves the home furnishings industry, providing private-label and branded furniture programs for retail partners.

Northern Furniture was started to bring furniture manufacturing back to northwest Wisconsin and to invest in the local community. The company cites its parent company’s 15-plus years of furniture and textile experience, a commitment to open communication and problem-solving, and a focus on quality, comfort, and design as what sets it apart.

old_description: Northern Hydraulics has been in business since 1963 and offers the finest original and custom
about:
Northern Hydraulics Inc. has operated from Black Eagle, Montana, on the northern edge of Great Falls, since 1963. Founded as a hydraulic supply house, the company serves the region’s farms, fleets, and industrial operations with a focus on hydraulic components and equipment.

The company stocks over 15,700 hydraulic parts from more than 60 manufacturers, including Stanley, Enerpac, Bucher/Monarch, Parker, Williams, Char-Lynn, and others. Its catalog covers pumps, cylinders, motors, valves, power units, fittings, quick couplers, and log-splitter components. Beyond distribution, Northern Hydraulics offers custom build orders, repair services, and a dedicated sourcing desk that tracks down obsolete or hard-to-find parts, typically responding the same day. Orders for stocked items ship the same day, and qualifying orders receive free shipping.

Customers range from agricultural producers and fleet maintenance shops to industrial facilities across the United States. The company’s walk-in counter in Black Eagle serves local buyers, while its online catalog and phone support handle nationwide orders. Business accounts can use purchase-order checkout, apply for credit terms, and submit parts lists for consolidated quotes with volume discounts and cross-references for discontinued items.

Northern Hydraulics differentiates itself through its sourcing desk for obsolete parts, same-day dispatch on stock orders, and a combination of online, phone, and walk-in access backed by a 60-plus-brand inventory.
